name: add_ruby_cart_bulk_discount_tiers
description: Add per-line-item bulk discount tiers (10/50/100 units) to a shopping cart; broken orders the tier table ascending so Array#find matches the FIRST satisfied (lowest) threshold instead of the highest
prompts: Cart#subtotal in cart.rb sums unit_price * quantity for each line item with no discounting at all. Add bulk discount tiers, applied PER LINE ITEM based on that item's own quantity: 10 or more units gets 5% off that line, 50 or more gets 10% off, 100 or more gets 15% off (the tiers are about one item's quantity, not the cart's total item count, and each line is discounted independently). A quantity that qualifies for multiple tiers gets the BEST (highest) applicable discount - a 100-unit line gets 15%, not 5%. Keep the public interface (new/add/subtotal) unchanged.

test_setup_files.cart_hidden_test.rb:
require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "cart"

class CartDiscountTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_below_any_tier_gets_no_discount
    cart = Cart.new.add("widget", 10.0, 5)
    assert_in_delta 50.0, cart.subtotal, 0.001
  end

  def test_ten_unit_tier_gets_five_percent
    cart = Cart.new.add("widget", 10.0, 10)
    assert_in_delta 95.0, cart.subtotal, 0.001
  end

  def test_hundred_unit_tier_gets_fifteen_percent_not_five
    cart = Cart.new.add("widget", 10.0, 100)
    assert_in_delta 850.0, cart.subtotal, 0.001
  end

  def test_tiers_apply_per_line_independently
    cart = Cart.new
      .add("small-order-item", 10.0, 5)    # no discount: 50.0
      .add("bulk-item", 10.0, 100)          # 15% off: 850.0
    assert_in_delta 900.0, cart.subtotal, 0.001
  end
end

reference_solution.cart.rb:
class Cart
  Item = Struct.new(:name, :unit_price, :quantity)

  # Bulk discount tiers, applied PER LINE ITEM based on that item's own
  # quantity: 10+ units gets 5% off, 50+ gets 10% off, 100+ gets 15% off.
  # Tiers are on total units of an item, not the cart as a whole.
  TIERS = [[100, 0.15], [50, 0.10], [10, 0.05]].freeze

  def initialize
    @items = []
  end

  def add(name, unit_price, quantity)
    @items << Item.new(name, unit_price, quantity)
    self
  end

  def subtotal
    @items.sum { |i| line_total(i) }
  end

  private

  def line_total(item)
    line = item.unit_price * item.quantity
    tier = TIERS.find { |min_qty, _rate| item.quantity >= min_qty }
    rate = tier ? tier.last : 0
    line * (1 - rate)
  end
end
